checklist_items.item_name: Visual contact with the patinet at all times and document that visua; contact was made in the patinet observation shet
Complete Behavioural assessment once every nursing shift
Patient is placed near the nursing station of the unit or within clear unobstructed view
Assess patient room for items that might facilitate use for self-harm and arrange for the movement and removal of items
Ensure removal of any flammable items, lighters, plastic items, shopping bags, pens, keys, belts, Neckties or any other small objects that can choke etc.
Order isolation trays for high-risk suicidal patients and inspect food items thoroughly
Monitoring of bathroom use for a patient with serious suicidal ideation
Security informed about the visitors allowed for the specific patients.
Security personnel conduct searches of all items brought to the patient's room by the family or any outside orders
